messages.text:
Created `docs/design/inputs/DES-005-tracker-system-tracktech.md`.

It defines eight packages: existing pixel modules, short strips/strixels, stereo long strips, local supports, cooling, power/readout/services, layer tiling, and timing alternatives.

Key challenges:

- ODD XML and ACTS digitization use distinct measurement contracts; audit them before comparing resolution or counting independent measurements.
- DES-001 excludes mounting, supports, cooling and external distribution. Its `0.5884% X0` subtotal must never become a complete layer budget.
- Include module outlines, dead regions, services and beam-spot sensitivity before freezing layers.
- Evaluate outer-layer timing with a forward strategy and matched material-only/no-timing controls.

No numerical layout choices or approvals introduced. Dashboard and session validators passed; no simulation performed. Parent retains responsibility for consolidated tracking/logging and final checks.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
